hni_signals: Sub-specialist rather than general OBGYN: holds a Post-Doctoral Fellowship in Urogynaecology and Pelvic Reconstructive Surgery on top of MBBS, MD and DNB, and practises complex pelvic-floor reconstruction (TOT/TVT slings, sacrospinous fixation, vaginal hysteropexy) alongside high-risk obstetrics and laparoscopic gynaecological surgery. Urogynaecology is a scarce sub-specialty in Hyderabad, which concentrates tertiary referrals. Member of IUGA (International Urogynecological Association) with a reported IUGA observership at Croydon University Hospital, London, UK. Reported First Prize for Oral Paper Presentation in Urogynaecology, Ahmedabad 2016. Was fronted by KIMS Hospitals as the named expert in its public patient-education content on prolapse and bladder pain syndrome (its own YouTube and Facebook channels) - hospitals reserve that for senior name-brand consultants. Recruited into Apollo's flagship Jubilee Hills campus after a decade at KIMS. Fellowship trained under Dr Anuradha Koduri. Awards, observership and society membership are summary-asserted and not independently confirmed.

Identity verified across two independent official hospital sources that agree on name, sub-specialty (urogynaecology), city and experience: (1) apollohospitals.com; (2) the KIMS group's own sites (kimscuddles.com per-doctor page, plus a kimshospitals.com doctor-profile page). ON THE MAHARASHTRA QUESTION FLAGGED IN THE BRIEF - the Maharashtra link is TRAINING AND REGISTRATION, NOT A FORMER POST. Search summaries indicate her MBBS is from Rashtrasant Tukadoji Maharaj Nagpur University and her MD OBG from Indira Gandhi Government Medical College (Nagpur), with registration on the Maharashtra Medical Council. Her actual former POST is in Hyderabad, not Maharashtra: Consultant Urogynaecologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad (reported circa 2015-2025). The Maharashtra council registration number given in a search summary is deliberately NOT recorded here as it was not independently confirmed. HUMAN CHECK NEEDED on affiliation timing: one search summary describes KIMS as past ('worked ... 2015 to 2025') while another describes it as present ('is working as Consultant Urogynaecologist at KIMS'). Apollo's own current site listing is treated as authoritative for the input row's Apollo Jubilee Hills affiliation, and the KIMS pages are recorded under other_profiles rather than hospital_profile.
